description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

UST is a technology company that helps clients create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions through innovation and technology. UST is seeking a Java Backend Engineer to work on a multi-vendor, multi-geo team building a high-scale enterprise platform, with responsibilities spanning Java application development, microservices, Kafka, Kubernetes, and Microsoft Azure.
Java backend engineer building Spring Boot microservices, Kafka event systems, and Kubernetes cloud applications

Responsibilities:
• Designed, developed, and maintained enterprise-grade Java applications using Java 18+, adhering to object-oriented programming principles and design patterns
• Developed and deployed Spring Boot microservices with RESTful APIs, dependency injection, exception handling, security, and ORM frameworks
• Built scalable and resilient microservices-based architectures to support distributed business applications
• Implemented and managed event-driven systems using Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topic management, message serialization, and performance tuning
• Deployed, monitored, and managed containerized applications on Kubernetes, including pod configuration, service discovery, scaling, and troubleshooting
• Worked with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, and Azure Cosmos DB for cloud-native application deployment and management

Requirements:
• ·       Bachelor's degree in computer science, or a related field is required as it is a complex specialized program
• ·       Experience in working Java Version 18 or above is mandatory 3-4 years of hands-on experience with Kafka
• ·       2-3 years of solid experience in Kubernetes Strong programming skills in Java, including object-oriented programming principles, design patterns, and familiarity with Java frameworks
• ·       Understanding of microservices architecture and experience in building and deploying microservices-based applications
• ·       Hands-on experience in developing Spring Boot applications, including dependency injection, ORM (Object-Relational Mapping), and REST API development
• ·       Knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud platform, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL or COSTMOS DB
• ·       Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD) practices, including automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment strategies
• ·       Proficiency in writing SQL queries as per industrial standards, fine-tuned for optimization
• ·       Strong problem-solving abilities, good communication (written & verbal) skills, and the ability to work effectively in a team are also important for this role
